name: NinjaDraw – Create Diagrams, Sketches & Visual Workflows
author: Yalogica

sections.description:
Transform static text into visual masterpieces with NinjaDraw. Perfect for educational blogs, business dashboards, project planning, and creative storytelling. Whether you’re a blogger, educator, marketer, or developer, NinjaDraw empowers you to design diagrams directly in WordPress – no coding or design skills needed! Seamlessly integrate flowcharts, brainstorming boards, and custom illustrations into your posts, pages, or sidebars.

📗 DOCUMENTATION
🔥 NINJADRAW PRO

✨ Perfect for:

✅ Explaining workflows with flowcharts
✅ Visualizing ideas via creative mind maps
✅ Building tutorials with annotated diagrams
✅ Designing wireframes, timelines, or organizational charts

✨ Key Features:

✅️ User-Friendly Interface: Create diagrams in seconds with zero learning curve.
✅️ Custom Styling: Choose colors, fonts, and line styles to match your brand.
✅ Shortcode & Block Support: Embed diagrams anywhere using Gutenberg blocks or shortcodes.
✅️ Save & Reuse: Store templates and reuse diagrams across your site.
✅ Responsive Design: Diagrams look sharp on desktops, tablets, and mobile.
✅️ GDPR-Compliant: No data tracking or external servers – your work stays private.

✨ Works With:

✅ Page Builders: Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Brizy, etc
✅ Themes: Avada, Divi, Flatsome, Astra, and popular WooCommerce themes, etc

✨ SEO-Optimized Highlights:

✅ Create diagrams in WordPress for tutorials, presentations, and data visualization.
✅ Build flowcharts, mind maps, and sketches without leaving your editor.
✅ Boost user engagement with hand-drawn style diagrams optimized for SEO.
✅️ NinjaDraw: The #1 tool for WordPress diagramming, visual brainstorming, and flowchart creation.

✨ Effortless Diagram Creation

Harness the power of Excalidraw’s intuitive tools directly in your WordPress editor. Create professional mind maps, process charts, and wireframes with drag-and-drop simplicity.

✨ Why Choose NinjaDraw?

  • Seamless Integration: Works with Gutenberg, Elementor, and all major themes.
  • Export Options: Save diagrams as PNG/SVG for sharing or offline use.
  • Privacy First: GDPR-compliant – no data collection without consent.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “NinjaDraw”.
  3. Click Install Now and activate the plugin.
  4. Use the Gutenberg block or shortcode [ninjadraw id="123"] to embed diagrams!
sections.faq:
Can I use NinjaDraw with Elementor?

Yes! NinjaDraw works seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg, and all major page builders.

Are diagrams responsive?

Absolutely! Your diagrams adapt flawlessly to all screen sizes.

Is NinjaDraw GDPR compliant?

Yes! We don’t collect or store user data without consent.
